texts: Companion opened on the phone. Start its connection service, then choose Connect Companion here.

USB or Android's paired wireless debugging authorizes ADB. Companion pairing separately authorizes this Mac's app catalog, handoff and phone dashboard. Select its authorized ADB device, install/open the companion if needed, then start its connection service on the phone.
This installed DroidBridge app can reopen for phone launch requests.

If no ADB device appears: enable Developer options and USB debugging on Android, connect USB, unlock the phone and accept its debugging prompt. A QR code does not grant ADB access. Revoke an untrusted Mac from either companion UI. If a local credential becomes unreadable after an unsigned update, use Forget Pairing on This Mac, remove the old trust on the phone, and pair with a fresh link.
